column1: # EXP-2026-11-23-M4.8b building-level reference table. Tab-separated, 8 columns:
# id  country  shard  stream_offset  record_index  ref_lat  ref_lon  reference
# Records are addressed by (shard, decompressed stream offset, record index), as in
# EXP-2026-11-08-M4.8b-poi-refs.tsv; point_census.py refs --refs reads this file
# unmodified.  Only discrete buildings / structures are included: airport reference
# points, ship berths, large parks and estate centroids are rejected.  Every source
# is Wikipedia or Wikidata (never OSM); retrieved 2026-11-23.  The precision printed
# below is the uncertainty floor: Wikidata P625 declared precision in degrees, or
# the rounding of the Wikipedia decimal when P625 has no usable precision.
# P07 Key West Lighthouse — a discrete lighthouse building (Wikidata type landmark).
# P08 East Martello Museum — the Martello fort/museum building, not the surrounding park.
# Wikipedia title redirects to Martello Gallery-Key West Art and Historical Museum.
# P11 Pacific Tsunami Museum — a single museum building in Hilo.
# P12 Lyman House Memorial Museum — a single museum building in Hilo.
# https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q6708046 ; P625 precision -1e-05 deg (invalid); Wikipedia decimal
# 19.72166667,-155.09111111 rounded to 1e-8 deg is the uncertainty floor (~1.1 m).
# P13 Kauai Museum (Albert Spencer Wilcox Building) — a single museum building.
# P14 Moorish Castle — the castle on the Rock of Gibraltar, a discrete structure.
# P15 Las Palmas Cathedral — a single cathedral building.
# P16 Museo Canario — a single museum building in Las Palmas.
# P17 Brandenburg Gate — a discrete monument building in Berlin.
# Located by tools/point_census + point_move_poi name walk (scratch locate_multi.py):
# P18 Duomo di Milano (Milan Cathedral) — a single cathedral building.
# POINT011 stream 0x473e788 record 614, name 'DUOMO DI MILANO'.
# P19 Torre di Pisa (Leaning Tower) — a discrete tower building.
